acceptance.text: Image search uses available providers in order and falls back on rate limit or failure without exposing secrets
Selected images persist with required source attribution and provider policies
Search and selection are authenticated, bounded and tested

spec.expected_behavior: Learners can find and persist attributed images using provider fallback
spec.observed_behavior: Go search returns 503 and deck image input is ignored
spec.rollback_plan: Revert the commit; no schema change. Unsetting PEXELS_API_KEY disables Pexels without a code change.
